name: Payments or claims split to stay below internal approval limits
description: Payments, claims or contracts are broken into amounts just under internal authorisation limits.
fp: Routine small recurring purchases and budget-driven phasing can resemble this.

links.fp: Budget cycles and instalment schedules can create similar patterns.
